1:
Why hello, Mitsuki-kun. That lunch looks
delicious.
3:
Oh, Sensei. Coming to the classroom during
lunch break... Is something the matter?
4:
No, nothing in particular. I just came to
see how everyone's doing.
7: Um... Do you really mean it?
9:
I mean, does this lunch really look
delicious?
10: Ah, that. Of course I'm not lying or joking.
12:
Hm? Inside that neatly made lunch, there's
some unidentified black object... What is
that?
13:
Ugh... Um, just this one thing kind of...
didn't turn out so well...
14: But it'd be a waste to throw it out.
15:
It's so black I wondered what it was... It's a
fried egg?!
16: You're still no good at fried eggs, huh?
17:
Huh? Sensei, how do you know I'm bad at
making fried eggs?
19:
W-Well, you see... I know these things about
my students!
24:
Did you make everything besides the fried
egg yourself? It's nicely done!
25: All the rest was my mom...
27: Only the fried egg is mine.
29: I just can't get any better at it.
30:
I've tried all kinds of things... What am I
doing wrong?
31: (Hmm... I went and got her all down.)
33:
My mom made everything except the fried
egg.
34: Ugh... Why can't I get it right?
35:
No, I'm saying this fried egg looks tasty
too.
36:
But Sensei, you couldn't even tell it was a
fried egg...?
37: Ah, no, well, um... Sakurai said so!
38:
He said burnt fried eggs aren't bad either,
that they look tasty!
41:
I see~ So Tomo-chan doesn't hate this
fried egg. Ahaha...
42:
(I meant to cheer her up, but I just said
something insane.)
43:
All right, I'll teach you how to make a fried
egg!
44:
I'm actually pretty good at teaching, you
know. I taught you how to swim, didn't I?
45:
Huh...? I don't think our class has ever had
a swimming lesson from you, Sensei...
46:
Aren't you confusing us with another
class?
47: Oh, oh, is that so? So it was!
49:
Still, I can teach you how to make a fried
egg, you know?
50: Okay... But I want to work at it on my own...
51: I see, understood. Do your best.
53:
(She sees me as a teacher, so suddenly
offering cooking lessons was a bit of a
stretch...)
54:
(It's not like I look like the home ec
teacher...)
